items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: And you remember the first one you heard pick? Did Newton pick too? ... Yeah, he picked but he did more bowing.

ctx.x: Bow, bow. Most all of them. All of them bowed. Very few. Um, not very much picking.
And you remember the first one you heard pick? Did Newton pick too?
Yeah, he picked but he did more bowing. Mm-hmm. This guy Ellick was a very good picker and also a bow. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
